scientific_integrity: The claim is a self-contained proof of a sharp regular-grid moment error and a full equality classification for the complex two-mode circle subspace. Published Fourier aliasing and the Gamma reflection formula are standard ingredients and are not claimed as new. No independent audit or independent novelty certification has occurred.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers only 1<p<2, equal-weight complete regular circular grids, and the complex span of 1 and z.
It does not solve optimal placement of arbitrary weighted nodes, arbitrary polynomials or all finite-dimensional Lp spaces.
An equivalent statement in earlier exact periodic quadrature or norm-discretization literature remains a publication-priority risk.
title: Sharp two-mode \(L^p\) circle sampling distortion and zero-on-grid extremizers
